description: Kiroween rules require the /.kiro directory at the repo root, outside .gitignore; ignoring it can disqualify the submission. Whenever .gitignore is edited, this hook runs a shell check that fails loudly if .kiro is ignored.
name: Guard: .kiro must never be gitignored

then.command: if git check-ignore -q .kiro .kiro/specs .kiro/hooks .kiro/steering 2>/dev/null; then echo 'KIRO-GUARD FAIL: .kiro is ignored by .gitignore — this can disqualify the Kiroween submission. Remove the ignore rule.'; exit 1; else echo 'KIRO-GUARD OK: .kiro is not ignored.'; fi
